mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility above 6% indicates residents are staying at home, which drains weekday and weekend discretionary footfall from retail-and-recreation venues and keeps RETAIL_REC below its last-four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 7.1 in t-0w and 6.3 in t-3w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is equal to or higher than the last 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above 6.0.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT falling to or below -10% signals that the public is cutting non-essential trips, and this trip suppression transmits to lower retail-and-recreation visits over the following two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is -11.4 in t-1w and -10.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT has crossed below -10.0.

mechanism_narrative: A positive WORKPLACES print above 0% together with GROCERY_PHARM dropping below 8% indicates a return to office routines and fading stockpiling, both of which release household time and spending to retail-and-recreation and raise RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is 2.3 in t-0w and GROCERY_PHARM is 7.1 in t-0w
failure_condition: If the joint condition holds but RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days fails to exceed the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, PARKS below -40% and TRANSIT negative indicate official or voluntary trip restrictions are broad enough to suppress retail-and-recreation mobility, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is -43.6 and TRANSIT is -10.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS is below -40.0 and TRANSIT is below -9.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The four-week decline in GROCERY_PHARM from 12.9% to 7.1% shows grocery stockpiling behavior is unwinding, and the freed household budget shifts toward discretionary retail-and-recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declines from 12.9 in t-3w to 7.1 in t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM continues to decline but RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains above 6% while WORKPLACES turns positive, the hybrid pattern leaves many workers at home and reduces lunchtime and after-work retail trips, so RETAIL_REC falls over one week despite office reopening.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 7.1 and WORKPLACES is 2.3 in t-0w
failure_condition: If the joint condition holds but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A further TRANSIT decline below the prior local trough of -11.4% would signal a new tightening step, and the restriction shock lowers retail-and-recreation visits within one week.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT falls below -11.4 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS stabilizing above -40% and TRANSIT recovering above -9% would mark a reopening impulse that restores out-of-home leisure trips, raising RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is -43.6 and TRANSIT is -10.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS exceeds -40.0 and TRANSIT exceeds -9.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the last 28 days.
